responsibility: This definition module declares Logitech-compatible terminal I/O for LONGINT values. It exports a Done status flag together with procedures to read a decimal long integer token from the current InOut input stream and to write a formatted long integer to the current output stream.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the LongIO pair: it only publishes the LONGINT I/O interface and Done flag, while LongIO.mod contains the actual token parsing, conversion, formatting, and InOut calls.
